model_contract.identity: Zero-based source-order ordinal; parent=-1 denotes root. Preserve distinct nodes even when authored_id repeats. Never key topology by authored_id.
model_contract.authored_id: Explicit ID before a delimiter; null for a bare caption by existing10 convention. Upstream nodeId still equals bare text for such nodes; source_witnesses records that separately.
model_contract.caption: Exact raw grammar description before sanitizeText, including newline and indentation. Not an asserted sanitized DB label or visible caption.
model_contract.shape: Source grammar family: default/square/rounded/circle/cloud/bang. The glossary records numeric type and upstream render-model spelling separately; none approves terminal glyphs.
model_contract.completeness: Every node declaration and every indentation-derived parent relation in each complete original is listed; blank lines and description-only frontmatter are not nodes.

manifest_provenance.record_hash_encoding: Canonical JSON encoding below; hash the entire unchanged fixture record including raw fallback witness.

schema_convention.use: Field names, source-order ordinal, root parent=-1, explicit authored_id/null convention and canonical model hash encoding only. Existing10 facts and projection are neither modified nor inherited.

source_lock_encoding: Sort by UTF-8 path relative to cases/mindmap/ (strip mindmap/); concatenate path, NUL, lowercase SHA-256 hex ASCII, LF; hash all bytes.
canonical_json_encoding: UTF-8 JSON; object keys sorted; compact comma/colon separators; Unicode unescaped; no terminal newline. Applies to model, witness, obligation, manifest-record and basis hashes.

findings.conclusion: Single (...) is ROUNDED_RECT=1, double ((...)) CIRCLE=3, [...] RECT=2, )...( CLOUD=4, ))...(( BANG=5. Use grammar, never fixture filename or description.

Mermaid addNode allocates id=this.count++ and separately stores nodeId=sanitizeText(id,conf); children are appended per declaration, without authored-id uniqueness or deduplication. Merman DB likewise allocates self.nodes.len() internal ids. BangCloud ordinals 1 and 2 share authored_id a but retain independent shapes/captions and edges to ordinal 0.

NODE_DESCR includes newlines and indentation, nodeWithId passes it unchanged as descr, MindmapDB passes descr to sanitizeText without trim. Merman parse_node_text plain case returns raw.to_string(), and continuation joins physical lines with LF. None of these facts licenses replacing raw caption with The root.

DB label is sanitizeText(raw,conf), then flattening marks labelType markdown. Pinned grammar/DB alone do not establish sanitizer output or visible Markdown whitespace normalization. Those later stages need separate evidence and explicit reviewed projection.

Direct-model duplicate internal/authored-id validation in the Merman ASCII consumer is not the source grammar. This proposal uses only upstream parser/DB/model semantics and never that consumer or its rendered output to infer identities/counts.
